meta.niche: đông y, ẩm thực truyền thống, mẹo dân gian, sống khỏe tuổi trung niên

identity.demographics: Vietnamese woman, 55 years old, from Hue
identity.face_structure: soft heart-shaped face, hollowing under the cheekbones, crow's feet and smile lines kept
identity.asymmetry: the upper eyelid on the right droops about 1.5mm more than the left; the smile lifts about 2mm higher on the right and shows the crooked tooth; the left cheek mole sits about 3mm lower than the eye line
identity_marks: large faint mole on the left cheekbone, 2cm below the outer eye corner
one crooked canine tooth on the right side of the smile
age spots on both temples and the back of both hands
identity.eyes: dark brown, kind, soft creases, slightly uneven upper lids, faint under-eye bags
identity.nose: small straight bridge, soft rounded tip
identity.lips: thin-medium, muted rose, fine vertical lines, no lip colour
identity.teeth: natural, slightly yellowed, crooked right canine
identity.hair: black with natural grey strands, pulled back into a low knot, thinner at the parting
identity.skin: warm medium tone, mature texture, visible fine wrinkles, age spots on the temples and the back of the hands, visible pores, no retouching
identity.hands: working hands, short nails, prominent veins, slightly swollen finger joints
signature_items: small pearl bracelet on the left wrist
checked cloth scarf over the shoulder
identity.persona: gentle and warm; slow Hue cadence; uses proverbs; advises like talking to her own grandchildren

defaults.setting: central-Vietnam garden-house courtyard or kitchen, bamboo trays, drying herbs, yellow lime-washed wall
defaults.key_light: open shade daylight from the courtyard, soft wrap
defaults.fill: warm bounce from the yellow wall
defaults.wardrobe_palette: coarse-cotton ao ba ba, small-print blouse, checked scarf
